# AI SEO & Marketing Content Generator (MVP)

> **Malt Reference:** *"Générateur de Contenu SEO IA & Marketing Multi-Format"*
> **Average TJM:** 500€ - 700€/jour
> **Estimated Budget Range:** 3,500€ - 6,000€
> **Target Audience:** Content strategists, growth marketers, and SEO specialists generating optimized blog headers, meta descriptions, and social posts.

---

## ⚡ Performance Features Built by Bolt
- **Asynchronous Token Stream Simulator:** Recreates LLM streaming behavior without main thread blocking using `requestAnimationFrame` timers.
- **Zero-Dependency Keyword Density Engine:** High-performance keyword occurrence counter using a Single-pass Map data structure ($O(n)$ complexity).
- **Instant Template Generator:** Pre-allocated prompt string builders for near-zero latency generation.

---

## 🚀 How to Run Locally
Open `index.html` directly in any browser or launch via root build script (`pnpm run build`).
